experiments.scope: Selected target sha256-r31-prefix-v1. One real matched chaining value (published first block M0) with the published W0..W12; each organizer seed drives the complete Step 3 of proof.md section 5.4 (V16 scan from a seed offset, W14, W18, E13, E15).
experiments.hypothesis: Given a matched chaining value satisfying Table 6 through step 12, Step 3 returns distinct ordinary collisions of the complete padded target on every trial.

experiments.scope: Replay of the pair table of proof.md section 5.2 from the starting point: per-W8 admissible-pair counts for the 112 listed W8 values against all 512 listed V7 words, and (trial 0) table size, key count and maximum key multiplicity. A trial returns a Step-3 completion pair only when all recomputed values equal the stated ones.
experiments.hypothesis: Every recomputed table statistic equals the value stated in proof.md (2560 entries, 664 keys, maximum multiplicity 8, per-W8 counts), so every trial returns a full collision.

experiments.scope: Step 3 on states combining a real first-block chaining value f(IV, M0) for seed-derived M0 (free words A-4, E-1..E-4) with an entry drawn uniformly from all 2560 table entries and admissible W6, W5 in a seed-chosen class. A trial returns a Step-3 completion pair from the published matched value only when Step 3 succeeds on that state.
experiments.hypothesis: The checked success frequency estimates the entry-weighted per-match Step 3 success probability on real free chaining words; proof.md section 6 uses pbar = 0.1050 and the Monte Carlo predicts about 0.112.

experiments.scope: The attack's counter-indexed first blocks M0(i) = BE_32(i)||BE_32(r) (r from the seed, counters disjoint across trials). Trial type k mod 3 tests one reduced match-word event on the real chaining words: h0 low half in the 108 key low halves (420 blocks), Kp - h1 in V6 (355 blocks), or the solved W5 satisfying the row-5 bits (89 blocks). A trial returns a collision receipt exactly when its event occurs at least once.
experiments.hypothesis: Under H-UNIFORM each trial type succeeds with probability 0.500, 0.500 and 0.503, so about half of the trials return a verified pair.
